svg.title: Pocket Reader — PCB top view (placement proposal)
svg.desc: Top view of the 45 x 24 mm board: footprints of the 64 parts, silkscreen, antenna keep-out area, dimensions and pin lists. Generated from placement.csv and connections.csv.
svg.text: 45.0 x 24.0 mm, 2 layers, 1.6 mm · 64 parts · to scale · Rev 1.0 · source: placement.csv + connections.csv

g.text: ⚠ EXAMPLE PLACEMENT PROPOSAL — NOT PRODUCTION READY
Tracks (routing) are NOT drawn. The copper pour shows fill only; no connection path is drawn.
No thermal or EMC optimisation has been done; the hot-loop area, FB return path and GND return currents are unverified.
The real placement must be done in KiCad and passed through DRC. This file is a technical drawing, not a Gerber.

svg.text: J1 USB-C: net names from the connections.csv RefDes=J1 rows; CC1=A5/CC2=B5 pinouts.md §5.3

g.text: Pin numbers are read from the connections.csv '(pin N)' field.
GND/EPAD is collected into a single row.
The castellation pad ORDER has NOT been verified against the module datasheet.
J2 — 24P FPC 0.5 mm pin list (pinouts.md §1 + connections.csv)
Names from the verified table in pinouts.md §1; nets from connections.csv.
ENIG · 1 oz copper · min 0.25 mm track

svg.text: Copper pour #f8fafc; the antenna keep-out area is hatched and has no copper. Pin labels are coloured by net CLASS.
Stitching vias (0.3/0.6 mm) were placed around the buck-boost by grid scan, avoiding the parts — 19 of them.
The mounting holes use the same pattern as the PCB bosses in case.scad (2.5 mm from the edge).
No courtyard overlaps a mounting hole — 64 parts clean.
